newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican police said making calls to sex lines.
newsitem.headline: Mexican police said making calls to sex lines.

text.p: Police in Mexico City are spending their time, and the public's money, making telephone calls to sex lines, television news programme, Hechos, said on Wednesday.

The programme said telephone calls to companies that sell sexually explicit conservation were billed to 20 police stations in one region of the city, and that authorities were having trouble paying the large bills.
"During the past year we had problems with the collection for these kinds of calls," local government spokeswoman, Esperanza Gomez was quoted as saying.
The television programme said that with the expensive bills going unpaid the police stations were having their telephone service restricted and were unable to receive calls.
The governent's security department told the television programme that it would crack down on the fantasy sex calls.
